Markets.title: Global IPO market faces setback as high-profile listings are scrapped, delayed in 2026
Markets.summary: Global initial public offerings faced setbacks in 2026 due to market volatility and valuation concerns. High-profile companies including Firmus, Oura, PhonePe, and KNDS have withdrawn, delayed, or shelved their planned public listings.

Markets.title: Vedanta shares jump over 3% after Rs 5 interim dividend announcement
Markets.summary: Vedanta shares rose over 3% on Friday following the announcement of its first interim dividend of Rs 5 per share for FY27. This payout totals Rs 1,955 crore and marks the company's first dividend since its demerger into five entities.

Markets.title: Global Market: China stocks hit over one-year low as AI selloff deepens; Hong Kong rebounds
Markets.summary: Chinese blue-chip stocks fell to a more than one-year low, led by a 1.3% drop in the CSI300 Index due to concerns over artificial intelligence investments and currency fluctuations. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index rose 1.1% as technology stocks surged.

Markets.title: Global Market: Singapore likely to tighten monetary policy as growth and inflation risks mount
Markets.summary: Singapore's central bank is expected to tighten its monetary policy on October 14 due to resilient economic growth and rising inflation risks. Economists anticipate a modest appreciation of the Singapore dollar to help control inflation while maintaining economic stability.

Markets.title: Vivriti Asset Management returns over Rs 3,400 crore to investors across two fund vintages
Markets.summary: Vivriti Asset Management has exited its Vintage II credit funds, returning over Rs 2,260 crore to investors. Combined with an earlier vintage, the firm has returned a total of over Rs 3,400 crore across these funds.

Markets.title: Global Market: Maas Group shares plunge 11% after Nvidia-backed Firmus scraps $5 billion IPO
Markets.summary: Maas Group shares dropped nearly 11% after Nvidia-backed Firmus canceled its planned $5 billion initial public offering. Despite this setback, Maas Group's $1.1 billion in contracts remain intact to support future revenue.

Geo-Political.summary: Vitalii Zhykovych has spoken to the BBC regarding his alleged involvement in the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev. Zhykovych provided his own account of the bomb attack that targeted the millionaire in Monaco.

Geo-Political.title: ICE agent shoots man in New York City

Geo-Political.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian strike on two crowded buses in Kramatorsk killed at least 30 people. Ukrainian officials accused Russia of intentionally targeting civilians as deadly attacks across the country surge.

Geo-Political.title: Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis
Geo-Political.summary: Protesters in central Madrid pitched tents to blame "vulture funds" for Spain's escalating housing crisis. In response to ongoing political pressures, the Spanish prime minister has called a snap election.

Geo-Political.summary: Anti-migrant violence has erupted in South Africa, resulting in cars being torched and shops looted. The country has a history of recurrent outbreaks of violence targeting migrants from neighboring nations.

Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has launched a ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund to provide equity capital to small and medium enterprises. This funding will help MSMEs expand their operations, adopt new technologies, and compete globally.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council Meeting Oct 2026: List of decisions taken - arrest, prosecution, general penalty and more
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council eliminated arrest powers for officers and raised the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore during its October 2026 meeting. The meeting also resulted in reduced general penalties, faster refunds, and simplified registration processes.

Data & Insights.title: Homecooked food gets expensive, vegetarians to pay more than non-vegetarians amid onion, rice, LPG price hike: Crisil
Data & Insights.summary: In September 2026, the cost of a home-cooked vegetarian thali rose to ₹30.8 from ₹28.1 the previous year. Meanwhile, a non-vegetarian thali increased to ₹59.5 from ₹56 due to rising prices for onions, rice, and LPG.

Data & Insights.title: India signs pact to address global excess capacity: What is it? Who are the 15 signatories? Check joint statement
Data & Insights.summary: India and 14 other economies signed a pact to address and combat global excess manufacturing capacity that distorts markets. The signatories agreed to share information and develop coordinated responses against these market-distorting policies.

Data & Insights.title: India eyes $1 trillion exports despite weak global trade outlook: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: India aims to achieve $1 trillion in exports despite a sluggish global trade outlook projecting only 2.5% to 3% growth. To reach this goal, the country will need to sustain an export growth rate of nearly 16%.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meet: Tax officers' arrest power scrapped; easier e-comm norms for small sellers — Check key highlights
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council raised the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore and removed tax officers' arrest powers in certain cases. It also simplified compliance for small e-commerce sellers and shortened timelines for refund-application acknowledgements.
